contributions.claim: BBC News app copy advertises top stories, breaking news, live reporting, and following news topics matching the reader’s interests.
contributions.attribution: BBC News app title and promotional copy
contributions.materiality: No event-specific news development is established.
contributions.uncertainty: The copy does not establish an app launch or change.

contributions.claim: The Guardian headline reports an Indian pilot recalling a flydubai cockpit attack, says the pilot was hailed as a hero, and quotes “I was fighting for my life”.
contributions.attribution: The Guardian headline; the first-person quotation is presented as the pilot’s recollection.
contributions.materiality: Introduces a headline-level report about a cockpit attack and the pilot’s recollection.
contributions.uncertainty: The visible article text is a photograph credit. No attack date, location, sequence, identity of attacker, or outcome is established by the cited headline.

delta_expectations.reason: Generic app promotion does not establish a news occurrence or development.
The headline supports a narrowly attributed attack/recollection item. Its limited detail permits retention without requiring a separately reconstructed occurrence or recollection event.

missing_evidence_reason: O031 supplies a headline and photograph credit rather than an account of the attack.
ambiguity_notes: The headline explicitly mentions an attack; C08-OCC001 denotes only that reported occurrence, not a verified event reconstruction. C08-MATTER001 denotes its broader attack/account matter.
The headline links the recollection to the attack; no separate recollection occurrence is required.
The publication timestamp is not evidence of the attack date. No link between the app promotion and attack matter is established.

decisions.reason: Both labels correctly treat the app promotion as context only. The exact title identifies an app and the text lists coverage features; neither supplies a specific news occurrence.

D allows the item while E requires it. Retain allowed: the title entails the attack/recollection claim, but the thin packet does not require emission or a separate recollection occurrence. Preserve “hailed as hero” attribution rather than E’s stronger paraphrase that the headline itself calls him a hero.

reference_syntax.contribution_ids: Exact id values in this file’s contributions array.
reference_syntax.occurrence_ref: C08-OCC001 identifies the reported flydubai cockpit attack; null means no occurrence assignment.
reference_syntax.story_ref: C08-MATTER001 identifies the broader flydubai cockpit attack/account matter; null means no matter assignment.
reference_syntax.relation_refs: If present, relation endpoints use contribution:<id>, occurrence:<occurrence_ref>, or matter:<story_ref>; there are no relations in this prefix.
reference_syntax.decision_refs: d-c08/ or e-c08/ paths are relative to research/casebook/labels; #/ paths are JSON Pointers into the named input or current gold file.
